Body.Content:
Admins and makers can create and manage filters for Filter-based Security through a simplified management experience. Filters define which Dataverse records users can access based on configurable conditions, helping organizations implement scalable, policy-driven record access without individually sharing records.

Customer benefit

Organizations can more easily configure and maintain Filter-based Security policies through a centralized experience. This simplifies security administration and makes it easier to manage dynamic record access as business requirements change

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: December CY2026
